intent: Bind an explicit immutable V2 panel declaration to existing original Material and Trainer custody before their journal effects; preserve V1/Shared literal and signature contracts.
semantics: V1 MaterialReceiptConfig and TrainingBootstrapConfig public fields are unchanged; V2 is a separate private-field immutable metadata wrapper.

Material V2 validates the original config/keys and whole panel before delegating to the original journal create/recover. The original constructor repeats its unchanged validation. The owned local result receives the same panel before return, with no await or external borrow in between.

Material V1 constructors retain None under Linux cfg. Original attest_experience and read_experience recheck a retained V2 panel before original journal access; Dataset and paired readback use the same original read_experience path.
Trainer V2 consumes the same original custody and original prebound peers, retaining the supplied declaration. V1 passes explicit None with the exact AGENTS /*panel*/ argument comment.
Actual Dataset context is authenticated through the original opaque readback, then the retained panel validates both initial and actual Dataset snapshots.

After the blocking queue, actual Source current and Dataset signature/context checks still occur before panel initial/training checks, original clock/deadline/Generator checks, and both original writer branches.
All signed payload formats, original owner keys/witnesses/files, transport purposes, peer/pidfd/deadlines, fence states, origin branches and native limits are unchanged.
Arc only retains immutable metadata within an owner. No Arc identity is used as cross-host evidence, and no new signature bit claims that an owner parsed a policy.

platform.material_v2: Linux cfg on import/type/field/calls; existing non-Linux V1 body semantics retained
platform.policy_contract: E-owned Linux-only Clone + Send + Sync immutable private fields, no Deserialize
